title: Water Bottle For Doors AND Open Source
script:
local bottle = game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://8678380361")[1]
bottle.Grip = CFrame.new(1, -0.150000006, -0, 0, -1, -0, -1, 0, -0, 0, 0, -1)
bottle.Name = "WaterBottle"
bottle.Parent = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Backpack

local f = Instance.new("Folder")
f.Name = "Animations"
f.Parent = bottle

local a = Instance.new("Animation")
a.Name = "Drink"
a.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://10482563149"
a.Parent = f

local a2 = Instance.new("Animation")
a2.Name = "Idle"
a2.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://10479585177"
a2.Parent = f 

local c = 0
local d = false
local hum = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid
local head = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Head
local sc = false

local ospeed = hum.WalkSpeed

local anim = hum:WaitForChild("Animator"):LoadAnimation(a)
anim:AdjustSpeed(0.25)
local anim2 = hum:WaitForChild("Animator"):LoadAnimation(a2)
anim2.Looped = true

bottle.Equipped:Connect(function()
  anim2:Play()
end)

bottle.Activated:Connect(function()
  c += 1
  if d and sc then
  return
  end
  d = true
  sc = true
  anim:Play()
  local li = Instance.new("PointLight")
  li.Name = "WaterLight"
  li.Color = Color3.fromRGB(85, 170, 255)
  li.Range = 7.5
  li.Brightness = 2.5
  li.Parent = head
  hum.Health += 5
  hum.WalkSpeed += 5
  task.spawn(function()
  while sc do
  hum.WalkSpeed = 21
  task.wait()
  end
  hum.WalkSpeed = ospeed
  end)
  task.wait(0.5)
  local Event = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("RemotesFolder"):WaitForChild("Caption")
  firesignal(Event.OnClientEvent, "I Feel Refreshed...", true, 1, true)
  task.wait(30)
  sc = false
  d = false
  li:Destroy()
  
  if c > 8 then
  local Event = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("RemotesFolder"):WaitForChild("Caption")
  firesignal(Event.OnClientEvent, "Welp Its Now Empty.", true, 1, true)
  bottle:Destroy()
  end
end)

bottle.Unequipped:Connect(function()
  anim2:Stop()
end)

print("Executed On ", os.date("%Y-%m-%d-%H-%M-%S"))
features:
A Water Bottle (maybe a magical one) tool

Heals 5 health
Adds 5 WalkSpeed and uhh locks it for 30 seconds
Adds a light
Adds captions
